```{r}
# 设置数据文件路径（请根据实际路径修改）
data_path <- "D:/Users/lenovo/Desktop/Prediction of anticancer drug resistance/dataset/CCLE/"

# 读取基因表达数据 (TPM)
expression_data <- fread(paste0(data_path, "CCLE_expression.csv")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# 设置行名为基因名（假设第一列是基因名）
rownames(expression_data) <- expression_data[,1]
expression_data <- expression_data[,-1]

# log2转换（添加伪计数1）
expression_log2 <- log2(expression_data + 1)

# 检查数据维度
cat("表达数据维度:", dim(expression_log2), "\n")
cat("基因数:", nrow(expression_log2), "细胞系数:", ncol(expression_log2), "\n")


# 读取拷贝数变异数据
cnv_data <- fread(paste0(data_path, "CCLE_copy_number.csv")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(cnv_data) <- cnv_data[,1]
cnv_data <- cnv_data[,-1]
```

```{r}
# 数据概览函数
summarize_dataset <- function(data, dataset_name) {
  cat("\n====", dataset_name, "数据概览 ====\n")
  cat("维度:", dim(data), "\n")
  cat("基因数:", nrow(data), "\n")
  cat("细胞系数:", ncol(data), "\n")
  cat("数据范围:", range(data, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("缺失值比例:", round(mean(is.na(data)) * 100, 2), "%\n")
}

# 应用概览函数
summarize_dataset(expression_log2, "基因表达")
summarize_dataset(cnv_log2, "拷贝数变异")
summarize_dataset(mutation_data, "基因突变")
```

##GSEA
```{r}
# 读取KEGG基因集数据 (假设是GMT格式)
kegg_gmt <- read_lines(paste0(data_path, "c2.kegg.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt"))

# 解析GMT文件
kegg_genesets <- list()
kegg_descriptions <- character()

for (line in kegg_gmt) {
  elements <- str_split(line, "\t")[[1]]
  pathway_name <- elements[1]
  pathway_description <- elements[2]
  genes <- elements[3:length(elements)]
  
  kegg_genesets[[pathway_name]] <- genes
  kegg_descriptions[pathway_name] <- pathway_description
}

cat("KEGG基因集数量:", length(kegg_genesets), "\n")
cat("平均每个基因集的基因数:", 
    round(mean(sapply(kegg_genesets, length)), 1), "\n")
```


```{r}
# 获取所有数据集的共同基因
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(expression_log2),
  rownames(cnv_log2), 
  rownames(mutation_data)
))

cat("共同基因数:", length(common_genes), "\n")

# 获取所有数据集的共同细胞系
common_cell_lines <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  colnames(expression_log2),
  colnames(cnv_log2),
  colnames(mutation_data)
))

cat("共同细胞系数:", length(common_cell_lines), "\n")
```



```{r}
# 子集数据以匹配共同基因和细胞系
expression_filtered <- expression_log2[common_genes, common_cell_lines]
cnv_filtered <- cnv_log2[common_genes, common_cell_lines]
mutation_filtered <- mutation_data[common_genes, common_cell_lines]

# 验证维度匹配
cat("过滤后表达数据维度:", dim(expression_filtered), "\n")
cat("过滤后CNV数据维度:", dim(cnv_filtered), "\n") 
cat("过滤后突变数据维度:", dim(mutation_filtered), "\n")
```




```{r}
# 安装可视化包（如果需要）
# install.packages(c("ggplot2", "pheatmap", "corrplot"))

library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

# 表达数据分布可视化
expression_melt <- as.data.frame(expression_filtered) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Gene, names_to = "CellLine", values_to = "Expression")

ggplot(expression_melt, aes(x = Expression)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "基因表达数据分布 (log2 TPM+1)",
       x = "log2(TPM+1)", y = "频率") +
  theme_minimal()



# 突变数据汇总
mutation_summary <- data.frame(
  NoMutation = rowSums(mutation_filtered == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  LowFreqMutation = rowSums(mutation_filtered == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  HighFreqMutation = rowSums(mutation_filtered == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# 突变频率最高的基因
top_mutated_genes <- mutation_summary %>%
  mutate(TotalMutations = LowFreqMutation + HighFreqMutation) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalMutations)) %>%
  head(20)

print("突变频率最高的20个基因:")
print(top_mutated_genes)
```
```{r}
# 保存处理后的数据
saveRDS(expression_filtered, "processed_expression_data.rds")
saveRDS(cnv_filtered, "processed_cnv_data.rds") 
saveRDS(mutation_filtered, "processed_mutation_data.rds")
saveRDS(kegg_genesets, "kegg_genesets.rds")

# 保存数据概览
data_summary <- list(
  expression_dim = dim(expression_filtered),
  cnv_dim = dim(cnv_filtered),
  mutation_dim = dim(mutation_filtered),
  common_genes = length(common_genes),
  common_cell_lines = length(common_cell_lines),
  kegg_genesets_count = length(kegg_genesets)
)

saveRDS(data_summary, "data_processing_summary.rds")

cat("数据处理完成！所有文件已保存。\n")
```
